payload.claim: `_whole_word` restates a helper the repository already defines twice, rather than importing one: `saffron/repos/mirror.py`'s `_word_pattern` (line 297-298) builds the identical pattern `rf"(?<![A-Za-z0-9_]){re.escape(name)}(?![A-Za-z0-9_])"` — the same character class, same lookaround construction, same purpose (does a name occur as a whole word in this text) — and `saffron/gates/core/witness.py`'s `_names_whole_word` (line 418-419) does the same job with `\b`. The diff's remit asks whether 'a helper the repository already defines' is 'imported, rather than restated'; here a third independent whole-word matcher is added instead of reusing or consolidating the existing ones, even though `mirror.py` has no import cycle back to `scheduler.py` that would block reuse.
